crossRefs.note: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
translations.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
translations.asv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
